title: Oh My Pi Custom Provider
description: Another entry under providers in models.yml. Here apiKey is the name of the variable that holds the key, not the key.

steps.description: This is another entry under `providers` in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`. The page says to add a custom provider here, and that `apiKey` is the name of the variable, not the key.
The provider is `ursinus`. `baseUrl` is `https://ursinus.ai/api/v1`, `api` is `openai-completions`, and `apiKey` is `URSINUSAI_API_KEY`, the name of the variable.
`models` lists one entry, `MODEL-NAME`, with a display name of `Ursinus model`, `reasoning` false, `input` as text, a `contextWindow` of 128000, and `maxTokens` of 4096.
